_comment: Maintained for the datpaq CLI. The CLI shows ONLY these interfaces in discovery commands (datpaq api, datpaq sample, splash). Inactive interfaces are still callable directly so existing scripts don't break. Source of truth is the website active catalog (API_ACTIVE_SLUGS / admin isActive). CLI command names differ for two slugs: dictionary→define, dns-lookup→dns. us-states matches the website/ProAPI slug (legacy `states` remains a command alias).
